data.title: Partial refusal of window replacement permit (Denkmalrechtliche Genehmigung)
data.case_title: Monument protection authority: partial refusal of window replacement permit
data.summary: The Untere Denkmalschutzbehörde of Hansestadt Beispielwismar approved replacing the ground-floor windows of the listed building at Lübsche Straße 14 with wood windows as requested, but refused the planned plastic-frame windows for the four upper-floor windows, in a decision dated 19 November 2026.
data.explanation: This is an official decision (Bescheid) from the local monument protection office. It allows new wood windows downstairs but refuses plastic-frame windows upstairs because the building is a listed monument in the historic old town. You may apply for a subsidy (Zuschuss) toward wood windows. If you disagree with the refusal, you can file an objection (Widerspruch); the app will show the deadline, which runs for one month from when the letter is legally considered delivered. If you do nothing, the refusal becomes final and only wood frames may be installed upstairs. Consider getting advice from an architect familiar with monument protection rules or a lawyer if you want to contest the decision.
